_how: Copy to ict/config-india.json in the folder you work from, then edit. Every key is optional.
_profitable: Notes EP-7: risk 1% or half a % until profitability. While false, risk is capped at unprofitable_risk_pct.
_size_factor: Psychology #9: lower size by 1/4 until it feels comfortable -> 0.75.
_option_delta: Used by size --option: an ATM option moves about 0.5 of the index. Use the real delta from your option chain.
_events: High-impact dates: RBI policy, Union Budget, US CPI/FOMC the night before. These dates are examples only, fill in the real ones.
